headline: Milan Mahendra Mehta files SEBI Takeover disclosure under Regulation 31(4) for substantial acquisition in Precision Wires India
sum: Milan Mahendra Mehta has disclosed a substantial acquisition of shares in Precision Wires India Limited (NSE: PRECWIRE) pursuant to Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, indicating a crossing of mandatory disclosure threshold.
detail: Milan Mahendra Mehta has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, the mandatory filing required when a person acquires shares in a listed company crossing specified thresholds. The regulation mandates disclosure within two trading days of acquisition. This filing indicates either a fresh acquisition or crossing of a threshold that triggers disclosure obligations. The specific acquisition value, share count, acquisition date, and acquisition price are not disclosed in the available public filing summary.
